---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a check, reporter, or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What are you trying to do that the tool doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. If it's a new check, note whether it would be AUTO
(machine-verifiable) or ATTESTED (human-declared), and which interface it
would implement.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you tried or thought about.
